description: This file defines a template class 'PingPongEnabled' that provides WebSocket ping-pong functionality, including starting pings, handling pong responses, and managing connection states. It includes methods for scheduling pings, handling pong responses and timeouts, and printing connection states. The class is designed to be inherited by other classes that implement WebSocket connections.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket ping-pong heartbeat functionality, including starting pings, handling pong responses, and managing connection states.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes the ping process by setting pong handlers and scheduling the first ping.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be called after a specified interval using the derived class's timer.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message over the WebSocket connection if the connection is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handles receipt of a pong message and schedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handles pong timeout event by closing the connection.

methods.name: printConnectionState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the WebSocket connection.
